title: Frozen COUST complex-cardinality failure attribution
purpose: Determine whether COUST fails on three/four-exit structures because of cross-seed cyclic alignment, per-seed slot-spacing collapse, cyclic matching bias, or non-transferable concentration confidence.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training audit of sealed C07/C08 COUST predictions; no new inference, checkpoint change, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution and delegated best-method choices without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed circular peak-field Teacher for C07/C08.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.audit_scope: Only the 20 frozen C07/C08 development worlds are read; C01-C06 are provenance-only and not read.

sampling.rule: Audit every sealed observation exactly once. Compare each seed, orientation-preserving cyclic ensemble and unrestricted assignment ensemble; no target-dependent decoder selection.

teacher.source: Frozen exact circular exit-center bins and signed sub-bin residuals.
teacher.valid_mask: All presence peaks define bearing targets; no missing bearing target is imputed.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: The audit creates no node or edge and calls no planner. Teacher identity is absent and cannot enter decoding.

split.historical_pollution_audit: No weights, predictions or thresholds change. Both C07 and C08 are diagnostic-only frozen development splits.
split.selection: No model or threshold selection; predeclared decision tests are evaluated on both splits.
split.transfer: The same diagnostic definitions and thresholds are applied unchanged to C07 and C08.

methods.main: Frozen-output attribution comparing three single seeds, cyclic and unrestricted ensembles, K=3/4 slot spacing, cyclic assignment optimality, kappa and concentration separability.
methods.baseline: Formal COUST cyclic ensemble and the preceding non-unimodal Slot Transport K=3/4 exact-set results.
methods.fallback: If unrestricted alignment and best single seed do not recover complex sets, classify the failure as representation/objective-level and stop COUST instead of applying post-processing.

failure_policy: Do not train, infer, widen tolerances, lower precision, select seed2, use unrestricted target assignment at deployment, or enter graph/planner. Any join or population drift stops the run.
retention: Retain summary, complex-cardinality table, attribution figures/source, environment, raw log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal. Source checkpoints and predictions remain immutable.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only deterministic frozen-output attribution over 45,942 observations
